riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine discipline, physical fitness, and coordination. Procedures must be followed exactly, and the crew must function as one unit.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Stability is central to this work. A one-second delay or an incorrect parameter at a firing position can cause serious problems. It suits disciplined, physically fit people who follow procedures without panic under pressure, with crew cohesion as the foundation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on practical work and follows discipline and rules (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「纪律强 + 体能好 + 能协同」凑一块的人——流程要卡得死，班组要拧成绳。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最讲的是「稳」——炮位上差一秒、错一个参数都可能出问题。适合纪律强、体能好、能在高压下按流程不慌的人，团队默契是底色。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实操、也守纪律和规则（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine a love of data, literature-reading ability, and sustained focus. Code must run and remain explainable, while data and mechanisms must stay in balance and the results must be written clearly.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops cross-domain translation. You must write scripts, understand statistics, and translate computational results back into biological questions. It suits people who enjoy examining data and can sustain long periods of focused work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and initiative (Investigative I + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱数据 + 能读文献 + 坐得住」凑一块的人——代码要跑通也要讲得清，数据和机制要平衡也要会写。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「跨界翻译力」——既要写脚本、懂统计，也要把计算结果翻回生物学问题。适合爱琢磨数据、又能坐得住冷板凳的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好思考、务实、也创造（研究 I + 务实 R + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy assembling a complete world one layer at a time, this career provides precise feedback. Every map you make is used in the real world.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value lies in moving upstream. AI maximizes map-production efficiency, but mapping standards and data processing become more demanding. People who understand surveying standards, data inspection, and 3D modeling are sought after across surveying, GIS, and autonomous-driving data.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「把一个图层一个图层拼出完整世界」的秩序感，这行会给你精准的正反馈——你的每一张图，都在被真实使用。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「往上游走」：AI 把制图效率拉满，但地图规范和数据处理的门槛反而更高，懂测绘规范、会做数据质检和三维建模的人，在测绘、GIS、自动驾驶数据领域都抢手。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Compensation, benefits, and job analysis specialists

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The practical reward comes from seeing people use the policies you design. A pay-adjustment plan becomes real, the team stabilizes, and employees accept the result. Recognition of the rules carries unusual weight in HR work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The strongest sense of achievement comes from using data to define rules. Compensation surveys and job evaluations directly shape how a department distributes pay and what a job is worth. Explaining complex compensation logic clearly and earning acceptance makes this one of HR's most technical specialties.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Conventional C + Enterprising E

breadcrumb.label: 薪酬、福利与岗位分析专员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最实在的是「做出来的制度真被人用」：你设计的调薪方案落地，团队稳定了、员工服气了，这种「规则被认可」的成就感，是 HR 领域最有分量的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的是「用数据定规则」：你做的薪酬调研和岗位评估，直接决定一个部门怎么发钱、一个岗位值多少钱。把复杂的薪酬逻辑讲得清楚、算得服众，是 HR 领域里最有「技术含量」的活之一。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine speed, consistent flavor, and heat tolerance. Dishes must cook properly and taste right, requiring balance between pace, consistency, and teamwork.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops fast hands and consistent flavor. Cooks must control the stove, season accurately, and withstand peak service. It suits hands-on people who tolerate heat, care about taste, and enjoy turning ingredients into satisfying food.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, business activity, and orderly processes (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手快 + 稳味 + 不怕热」凑一块的人——菜要炒得开也要味得准，速度和稳定要平衡也要会配合。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手快与稳味」——灶要控得稳，味要调得准，高峰要扛得住。适合动手强、不怕热、对味道有追求的人，也享受把食材变美味的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、企业、也守序（现实 R + 企业 E + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who can both go deep and step back: immerse themselves in archives and storage areas, then zoom out to see the whole picture and negotiate resources.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The compelling part of this work is giving silent objects a voice. Research and display can make a visitor spend ten minutes with an unremarkable old object. Turning an exhibition from an idea into reality creates tangible satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Artistic (A) + Investigative (I) + Social (S)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「能钻进去、又能跳出来」的人——钻得进故纸堆和库房，跳得出来看大局、谈资源。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的地方在于「让沉默的东西说话」：一件不起眼的旧物件，经过你的考据和布展，能让观众停下来看十分钟。把一个展览从想法变成现实，那种成就感很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 艺术型 A + 研究型 I + 社会型 S

breadcrumb.label: Electrical And Electronics Installers And Repairers, Transportation Equipment

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines practical ability, care, and systems awareness. Electrical power must remain stable, faults must be isolated accurately, and safety procedures must guide every decision in confined equipment bays.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops persistence with electrical circuits. Workers must understand schematics and signals while patiently tracing faults in confined spaces. It suits practical, focused people who understand electrical systems and enjoy the moment every test indicator turns green.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, hands-on work and investigation (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 运输设备电气电子安装与维修工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「动手 + 细心 + 对系统敏感」凑一块的人——电要通得稳也要排得准，安全和规范要平衡也要敢钻舱。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和电路较劲」——既要把图纸和信号吃透，也要有在狭小管路里耐心排查的定力。适合动手强、坐得住、对电和系统敏感的人，也享受修好那一刻灯全绿的爽。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、动手、也钻研（务实 R + 钻研 I + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Family And Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The role fits people who treat daily life as a subject and the classroom as a stage. Household decisions have theory behind them, and teaching that theory can be engaging.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The field turns everyday life into an academic subject. Household management, consumer choices, and parent-child relationships can all become research questions, and each class connects directly to students' lives.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Artistic A

breadcrumb.label: 高校家庭与消费科学教师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把生活当学问、把讲台当舞台」的人——过日子也有理论，讲出来还特别有意思。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行有意思的地方在于「把生活变成学问」：日常的家务管理、家庭消费、亲子关系，都能拆成可研究的课题，教的每节课都跟学生真实生活连着。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy combining outdoor work with data-driven decisions, surveying can be a strong fit. It avoids constant office confinement and requires less social maneuvering, because the data demonstrates the quality of your work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: A rewarding feature of this work is seeing it embedded in real infrastructure. Years later, surveyors can pass a bridge and tell their families they measured its foundations. The field is technically demanding, rewards experience, and is not confined to an office.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「在山野里工作、用数据说话」的组合，测量这行很对味：既不闷在办公室，又不需要太多人情世故，数据就是你的成绩单。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的是「你的工作会被写进工程里」：几年后开车路过当年测过的立交桥，你能跟家人说「这桥的地基测量是我做的」。技术含量高、越老越吃香，而且不用坐办公室。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine attention to detail, composure, and willingness to serve on the front line of healthcare. The goal is clear images, safe patients, and the crucial views physicians need.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops warmth within rigor. Technologists must understand magnetic-field physics and sequences while reassuring patients who fear MRI examinations. It suits meticulous, composed people willing to work on the front line of healthcare who value helping physicians obtain crucial images.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and helping others (Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 稳重 + 愿在医疗一线」凑一块的人——图像清、病人安，帮医生拿到关键图。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「严谨里的温度」——既要懂磁场物理和序列，也要把怕核磁共振的病人安抚好。适合细致、稳重、愿在医疗一线的人，也享受「帮医生拿到关键图像」的价值感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、实干、也助人（研究 I + 现实 R + 社会 S）。

breadcrumb.label: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists work and accept judgment under high-risk conditions, this career profile is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to translate data into business. Professionals need analytical skills and the ability to explain insights persuasively. It suits curious, logical people who enjoy uncovering causes.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, clear standards, and business operations (Investigative I + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 市场研究分析师与营销专员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，市场研究分析师与营销专员职业诊断值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把数据翻成生意」——既要会算，也要讲得让人动。适合好奇、逻辑强、爱挖因的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、重规范、也讲经营（研究 I + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Packaging And Filling Machine Operators And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine sustained focus + steady hands + stable output. Parameters must remain accurate through continuous operations without errors, balancing physical work and procedures while handling problems.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops stability through repetition. Operators must adjust machines, read data, and avoid mistakes during continuous production. It suits people who can stay focused, have steady hands, and accept responsibility for output.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, order, and investigation (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「坐得住 + 手稳 + 稳产出」凑一块的人——参数要调准也要在连轴里不出错，体力和规程要平衡也要会处置。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在重复里保稳定」——既要会调机和看数，也要在连轴转里不出错。适合坐得住、手稳、也愿意为产量负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守序、也探究（务实 R + 守序 C + 探究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine love of nature + outdoor ability + coordination. They understand rangelands, negotiate with people, and calculate long-term impacts.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work suits people who love nature, dislike being confined to an office, and are willing to work patiently with people and land. Turning ecological data into implementable management plans and seeing rangelands recover creates strong satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and enterprise (Investigative I + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱自然 + 能跑野 + 会协调」凑一块的人——草场要看得懂，人要谈得拢，长远要算得清。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行适合爱自然、坐不住办公室、又愿意和人与土地磨的人。你喜欢把生态数据变成能落地的管理方案，看到草场恢复，满足感很强。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、务实也企业（研究型 I + 现实型 R + 企业型 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine resilience, steady hands, and respect for rules. Beams must be securely fastened and drawings correctly interpreted, while work at height requires both balance and coordination.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops courage and tactile skill. You need confidence at height, steady hands, and the ability to read blueprints. It suits resilient, rule-following people who want to learn hoisting and enjoy seeing a building grow from its frame.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, Conventional, and Enterprising preferences (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「皮实 + 手稳 + 守规矩」凑一块的人——梁要锁死也要读得懂图，高空和现场要平衡也要会协同。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「胆子和手感」——既要敢上高、手稳，也要读得懂蓝图。适合皮实、守规矩、又肯学吊装的人，也享受看一栋楼从骨架长起来的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、也守序（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about surveying and mapping and are comfortable making judgments in high-risk situations, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to pin the ground down with numbers. You must set up instruments, read coordinates, tolerate field exposure, and control errors within centimeters. It suits meticulous people who can focus for long periods and do not mind outdoor fieldwork.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and order (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Surveying And Mapping Technicians有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，测量与制图技术员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「用数字钉住地面」——既要会摆仪器读坐标，也要耐得住外业风吹日晒，还得把误差控在厘米内。适合细致、坐得住、不怕跑野外的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、探究、也秩序（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。
